notes.title: The new Adventure starts NOW!
notes.content:
Hey future Beasties trainer!

Today is the day!
Our first Kickstarter starts right NOW!
Support us on Kickstarter and be part of the development of Beasties from the very beginning!

[previewyoutube=c3S9-u4dbu8;full][/previewyoutube]

About Beasties:
Beasties is a lovingly hand-drawn 2D top/down monster trainer game with a turn-based match-3 combat mechanic, where you take on the role of a Beastie trainer. Form alliances with Beasties, earn money with farming, explore the world, craft food for the Beasties and craft various items. Collect and manage resources, discover small and big secrets and solve countless side tasks and challenges in a peaceful (wholesome) and humorous world.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592600/Beasties__an_adorable_Monster_Trainer_Match3__Farming_game/

Key Features:

 Sophisticated genre mix of Monster Trainer, Match-3 & Farming 
 Easy to learn, hard to master Turn-Based Match-3 Combat
  Team up with Beasties, upgrade and customize them to your gameplay
 Earn money with farming
 Sell your goods or craft new ones on the market
  Be a co-producer 🚀 and part of the development of this game
  The game is 100% Plant-Based 🌾🌱 and we care about diversity 👧👳🏼‍♂️👴🏽👩🏾‍🦰
 The game will be released on PC (Steam, Gog etc) and on Nintendo Switch.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33933433/60b799939ae8ec6c6d0da62762eb6109ffaac46f.jpg

Follow us on your prefered Social Media platform!

❤Your team at rokaplay❤

notes.title: Discover the secrets of The Forgotten Land on June 25!
notes.content:
A clue leads you on a journey to a mysterious place..

The Forgotten Land will be released on June 25!

The Forgotten Land is an exciting turn-based "Combat & Puzzle Match 3" with streamlined RPG and Management elements in a dark fantasy setting. Set up a sheltering camp, improve your heroes' abilities and unlock tactical bonuses.

Show your combat skills! 
In turn-based battles you have to outwit your opponents' tactics, thwart their chances for counterattacks and cleverly use the special powers of your team.

Grow along your journey.
Develop your team and improve your heroes' individual abilities!

notes.title: General Update 2.2.0 & Chinese Localization
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27030967/249d4d479b86cb4b675fa8b0c0a54548d87acca1.jpg
Dear chess masters,

We have revised the game according to your ratings and added a Chinese localization for all chess fans in and from China. Please continue to share your suggestions and opinions about the game with us. We are happy about every review!

The improvements in detail - Changelog 2.2.0:
- Randomized Animation
- Computer-figures now move on the board to their new position (instead of instant placing)
- Chinese localization added
- Minor Puzzle-Bugs fixed
- UI-Problems fixed
- Localization-Errors fixed

notes.title: Stranded Sails – Shovel & Spyglass replace Master Sword & Shield
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025590/087d82e7de9d06f29e86c3a1c3b9396948cae2d4.jpg

Unique mix of adventure gameplay in the vein of Legend of Zelda and Stardew Valley-esque farming simulation

https://store.steampowered.com/app/943260

Features:

 Unique mix of adventure and farming simulator: Prove yourself as a dauntless adventurer and crafty farmer!
 Exploration, crafting and farming: You will need better and better equipment and enough food for your journeys deep into the heart of the islands!
 Story-driven quests: Quests tell the game's story and lead you from one adventure to the next!
 Tricky puzzles and challenges: Fire up those tiny grey cells to solve the many exciting riddles!
 Creation and expansion of a survivors' camp: Manage your provisional camp to survive!
 Mysterious islands and dangers: Solve the secret of the cursed islands and fight against supernatural threats! 


Take a first peek at the game with our Pre Alpha-Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MObtP-h4-Qg&t=

notes.title: Say hello to update 2.0.2 - New UI, new difficulty and more puzzles!
notes.content:

Completely new UI
85 new puzzles to solve

notes.title: 3D Chess v1.2 now available! New boards! New figures! Linux!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27030967/4cf7d30ababd668b84f18bf8b1ea774a15c58acd.jpg

Dear 3D-Chess players.
We are very happy to announce our first major update of 3D Chess! The following features have been added:
- New background "Space"
- New background "Fantasy Town"
- New chess pieces "Voxel-Fantasy"
- Linux-version
- 2D board rotated when playing black
- minor usability enhancements
- some smaller bugfixes
Hope you enjoy the new features, have fun,
Tassilo @ bumblebee. :ChesspieceQueen:
